sources.name: TFF Fantasy public rules and home page
sources.observed: Country League is documented; rankings use cumulative points. Public home page offers login and registration. No public historical manager lineup or selection export was verified.

sources.name: Existing repository official integration
sources.observed: Authenticated integration implements player statistics and player histories only. No manager ranking, lineup, captain, bench, card or manager-score client or archived dataset found.

permission_assessment: Automated access/reuse authorization for other managers' selections was not established; no authenticated manager endpoint was queried or inferred.
leakage_assessment: Current cumulative rank cannot establish prior-week rank. No time-stamped pre-deadline manager picks or historical rank snapshots were found. Retrospective lineups, if later obtained, cannot be treated as pre-deadline intelligence.
recommendation: Do not integrate manager consensus into prediction. Seek explicit permitted access and prospective timestamped rank/selection snapshots, then compare lagged top-manager and all-manager consensus with unchanged Phase 40 baseline on identical pools and rules.
